lines.text: *Clatter, crash, thud!*
A loud noise rings out as someone tumbles into the warehouse.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Ugh... oof!

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Oh, quit your bellyaching. I just gave you a little tap with my foot. What's all that yelping about?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: You did kick him right in the gut, though.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: That's why I told him to brace his stomach. So this one's on him.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Urk... blegh!

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Good grief... you're cleaning all this up later, got it?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: By the way, Lion really needs to get their act together. Security's way too lax.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Rosanna, over here.
In the warehouse, Sakura stops before a heap of sacks.
She pulls a knife and slashes one open, spilling its contents across the floor.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Found it.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: It's Mist.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: You sure about that?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Absolutely. Judging by the color and texture, there's no mistake.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Heh... that many, huh?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: This is your little hub for distributing them?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Ugh... aargh...

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Hey! I'm asking you something, damn it.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: I-I don't... know...!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Haha! Look at how polite he is. Truly hilarious.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: But seeing they're using someone who's been caught before... Lion must really be short on talent.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Vi...per...!

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: What the hell are you doing here...?!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Oh my, did you really just ignore a question from Rosanna of the Underworld Queen?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Yeah, I'm about to lose it.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Eek!

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: I-I swear I don't know anything! I'm just in charge of the Mist here!

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: If someone comes asking for it, I give it to them! If someone brings it to me, I-I just stash it here! That's it! That's all I do!

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Hmm... looks like this place is a hub, all right.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: But no telling where it's coming from or where it's going.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Carlson, do you know anything?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: N-nothin'! I don't know jack! I'm just a small fry, so I ain't got a clue about stuff like that!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I figured as much, but it's disappointing how little you know.
*Stomp, stomp, stomp, stomp*
The sound of countless footsteps fills the air.
A glamorous woman steps in and comes to a halt. Behind her, a line of burly men stands like sentinels.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: ... Are you the ones who did this to my subordinates?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Oh my, if it isn't the boss of Lion?

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: I'm the one asking here, you damn serpent!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Well, aren't you eloquent.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: We did it, duh. Can't you tell?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Madam, how long did it take you to take care of them?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Hard to say, but I recall it being briefer than the time one takes to change one's attire.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: ... And what, pray tell, does the Underworld Queen want with my organization?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: What else? This, of course.
Rosanna gives the pile of sacks a few light taps.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I'll make this quick. Where'd you get these, and where are they headed?

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: Why do you ask?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: How about you start by answering my question?

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: Why should we—no, why should I do as you say?

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: Lion doesn't answer to Hedonia or Seimeikai.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: We're on equal footing here, so I suggest you show some respect for how things work in this business.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Ah, the rules of this business? I know them all too well.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: The strong can do whatever they want to the weak. Isn't that right?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: That's why I'm here to wreck your business.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I have the power.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: You don't.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: You've got that right.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: There may be all kinds of rules, but in the end, the strong always exploit the weak.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: And now... that power is ours.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Oh, yeah? What've you got? Those guys standing behind you?

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: No.
*Beep*
The monitor in the warehouse flickers to life.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: Nice to meet you, Rosanna, Sakura, and Viper.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: I'm Sixo. I don't believe we've spoken face-to-face before.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: Looks like you've got business with Lion, whom I'm watching over.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: So, what is it you want?

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: And just so we're clear, don't even think about getting rough.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: So... this is Lion's power?

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: Yeah, the untouchable Sixo.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: Lion has joined forces with her.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: Sixo's a force of nature.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: She makes us capable of things we wouldn't have dared even dream of before.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: She knows secrets no one else even imagines, and she does it effortlessly.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: She manipulates information like it's nothing, and her lobbying? Flawless.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: Thanks to her, Lion's soaring to new heights.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: No doubt about it, our influence on the Outer Rim is stronger than ever.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: Hell, we're strong enough to even go toe-to-toe with the Underworld Queen.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Heh... hahaha!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Hahaha!

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: ... Heh!

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Hey, Lion.
Rosanna approaches Lion and drapes an arm around her shoulders.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: You really think that thing can save you right now?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I'm about to put you in a little friendly headlock, so tell me, how's she supposed to save you before your head goes pop?

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: That's enough,

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: before I make Hedonia's secret ledgers public.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: The same goes for Seimeikai. It seems you've been buying some... interesting toys off the Dark Net in bulk lately.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: If this information gets out, you know better than anyone just how disastrous it would be for your organizations.
*Grrk*
Rosanna puts Lion in a headlock and squeezes tight.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: Ugh... aargh!

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Now, Lion... tell me, where do the Mist come from, and where are they headed?

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: S-Sixo!

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: I've just sent part of Hedonia's secret ledgers to the Central Government Inspection Department.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: They'll be in touch soon.
*Grrk*
Rosanna tightens her grip around Lion's head.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: U-ugh...!
The men behind Lion flinch and take a step forward.
Across from them, Sakura stands in their path.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Do mere underlings presume to interrupt a conversation between the bosses?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: The dignity of the title "boss" must not be diminished, so I suggest you cease at once.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: To be perfectly clear, this is by no means a mere suggestion.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: It is a warning.
Lion's men stand frozen in place.
*Grrk*
Rosanna tightens her grip even more.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: Aarghhh!

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Come on now, answer me before that pretty head of yours pops.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: Rosanna, shall I tell everyone what you did to claim the boss's seat?

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: Sakura, I've secured a complete list of all prohibited items you purchased on the Dark Net. If I release it to the press, Seimeikai is finished.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Rosanna, Sakura, this Sixo just keeps yammering on, huh?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Don't know, don't care. If she's got something to say, say it out loud!

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Or perhaps she could come and speak in person.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Hear that?

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: This can't be helped. I didn't want it to come to this.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: I'll expose all of the Underworld Queen's illegal dealings without going through the press.
*Grrk*
Rosanna's arm locks around Lion's head, pressing down with relentless force.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: Aarghhh!

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Heard that crack? Just a little more and it'll split open.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: I-I'll talk! I'll talk!

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Now, that's more like it.
Rosanna releases the headlock.
Lion wheezes, eyes burning with a murderous glare.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Out with it. I don't have all day.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: I-I'll give you a list... and it's a long one.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Hmm... Wouldn't you rather talk to me?

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: Interesting. Lion, are you betraying me?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Hmm...
Sakura approaches the monitor.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Fear wielded through threats...

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: So this is how you commanded the powerless, treating them as mere extensions of yourself.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Yet you must understand this:

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Whether human or Nikke, none fear the empty threats of some unseen, unknown entity

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: as much as they fear the violence that stands before their very eyes.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: You have neither face nor voice; you are nothing more than a presence confined behind a screen.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: I'll crush you without mercy.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: What could you possibly do from there?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: What, precisely, can you do to us right now?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: At most, you can write a few more lines.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Empty threats crumble so easily in the face of real violence.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: You can do absolutely nothing

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: to those who have nothing to lose, or fear nothing...
*Swish*
*Crackle*
Sakura's shuriken hits the monitor, sending sparks flying.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: ... Or even to those who walk in the light.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Good job! ♡

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Now, will you hand over the list?

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: Only on one condition.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Oh my, really now?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Let her talk. I want to hear what she has to say.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: In exchange for the list, let us join Hedonia or Seimeikai.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: I will step down from the boss position. A senior position is all I need.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: B-Boss... What are you—

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: Shut up, Carlson. I'm talking here.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: You've got to be kidding me. Why on earth would we take in an organization that uses guys who just tumble over from a single kick?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: To be precise, it was a kick to the abdomen.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: If Sixo attacks us, we're finished. Everything she's done to get this far has been through manipulating information.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: Now that she's no longer on our side, she'll obviously exploit our weaknesses.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: So Hedonia or Seimeikai has to step in and protect us.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: And if we say no?

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: Then we'll fall apart. And people with nothing to lose can do anything.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: For the record, Seimeikai is not an organization that just anyone can join.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: You must undergo a strict screening process to be accepted.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: What? Are you saying Hedonia accepts any Tom, Dick, and Harry?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: I never said that.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Fine. I'm feeling generous today.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: I'll let you join the Peony Association.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: The Peony Association's a little...

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Haha, shame Moran isn't here to hear this.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Anyway, I'll decide after seeing the list.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: If that list's enough to hit Sixo where it hurts, what the hell, I'll even let you join Hedonia.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: But if you're lying or it turns out to be nothing at all... heh, who knows what I might do then?

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: ... That's not going to happen.
Lion fiddles with her phone, then hands it to Viper.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Mm, good girl! ♡ Didn't think you'd be this obedient.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Don't go setting up bombs or anything like that.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Hehe! ♡ That's only reserved for people of a certain level.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: All right, copying's all done.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Sakura.
Viper tosses Lion's phone to Sakura.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Take a look at the export logs.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: See anything familiar?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: I remember making a few transactions there.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Does it say where they're getting that thing from?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: The production facilities... are in the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: There are 23 of them in total.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: ... It's more than I had anticipated.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Since Fog Hollow got raided, their production probably took a big hit. Looks like they went with digging multiple tunnels.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Good, send those coordinates to her.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Okay! ♡

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: It's time we turned the tables.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Rosanna, about those export logs...
Sakura leans in and whispers to Rosanna, causing her eyes to widen.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: ... Are you sure?

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Yes, I'm certain.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: We could... make good use of this.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: That's correct.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: What is it? What is it? What are you two whispering about?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Viper, we're pulling out.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: What?! You're really pulling out now, after we've made it this far?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Did you think we'd stay in the Outer Rim forever? Got some business to take care of.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: There's someone Rosanna and I have to meet in the Ark.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: The Ark, all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: We're going to see Doban.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: ... Doban, the deputy chief? That lunatic?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: He's clearly obsessed with results and power... or maybe that's not the only thing?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: So I suppose you could call him a lunatic.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Why are you meeting him?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: To have a grown-up conversation.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Boss...

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: I'm not the boss anymore.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Wh-why did you betray Sixo and side with the Underworld Queen?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: W-with Sixo, we could have whatever we want...

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: we could have lived in style, so why do we have to side with these people who treat us like nobodies?

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: Now's the exact moment to bail.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: The great thing about Sixo is that she keeps a low profile.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: Whatever shady stuff she does behind the scenes never leaks out.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: Look at what happened in Fog Hollow. It was complete chaos, but in the end, Moran took the fall while Sixo got off scot-free.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: But I don't think that's the case anymore.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: Did you hear about the attack on the Ark?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Yeah, they said E.H. did it...

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: And you actually believe that? E.H. washed her hands of this and decided to become the Central Government's lapdog.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: The way I see it, that's Sixo's doing, though I have no idea what she's aiming for.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: Sixo's getting greedy.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: To be exact, she doesn't care whether people know she exists.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: She must have something to back her up. That's why she's so damn confident.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: The Mist production zones are expanding rapidly, and deals are booming.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: That's exactly what caught the Exotic and Underworld Queen's attention.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: She's bold and doesn't even bother hiding it.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: That's why we have to pull out now.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: She used to have the advantage of lurking in the shadows, but now she's playing a big shot in the underworld.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: It might be fine for now, but eventually, people like us are nothing but disposable.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: So yes, pulling out now and siding with the Underworld Queen is the smart move.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Boss... you've got real foresight.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: That's why I'm still alive, running the streets like a back-alley thug.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Are you happy with that?

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: What, being a back-alley thug?

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: ... Yeah.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: Life-changing opportunities don't just fall into your lap.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: Even if they do, you have to stake a lot since nothing's free in this world.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: I'm terrified of taking that gamble. If I lose, it's over.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: Does that mean we're stuck being a back-alley thug for life?

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: Of course not, life-changing opportunities do come.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: When that time arrives, you need to be ready to put everything on the line.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: And even if you lose it all, you've got to be strong enough to handle it.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: How do you even... prepare for such a thing?

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: How else?

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: You just live your life to the fullest.

lines.speaker: lion
lines.text: C'mon, let's go hustle the Nikkes.

lines.speaker: carlson
lines.text: O-okay!
